title: Shapes and Sides
intro: Eight small questions about flat shapes, each with a picture. Take your time.

questions.prompt: Bees build honeycomb cells in the shape shown. What is this shape called?

image.alt: An orange flat shape with six straight sides of equal length and six equal corners.

questions.explanation: A hexagon has six sides. Hexagons fit together with no gaps, which is one reason honeycomb uses them.

questions.prompt: How many corners does the shape in the picture have?

image.alt: A teal flat shape with three straight sides of equal length, pointing upwards.

questions.explanation: It is a triangle. A flat shape with straight sides always has as many corners as sides, so three.

questions.prompt: How many circles are in the picture?

image.alt: Five shapes spread out on a light background: three purple circles and two green squares.

questions.explanation: There are three circles and two squares, five shapes in all.

questions.prompt: What is the name of a flat shape with as many sides as the one in the picture?

image.alt: A green flat shape with five straight sides of equal length, with one corner pointing up.

questions.explanation: Five sides make a pentagon. The name comes from the Greek word for five.

questions.prompt: The square in the picture has been turned so that it stands on one corner. Is it still a square?

image.alt: A purple shape with four equal sides and four right angles, turned so that one corner points straight down.

choices: Yes, it is still a square
No, it has become a different shape
questions.explanation: Turning a shape does not change its sides or angles. A square standing on a corner is still a square.

questions.prompt: How many sides does the shape in the picture have?

image.alt: A teal flat shape with eight straight sides of equal length, like a circle made of short straight edges.

questions.explanation: It is an octagon, with eight sides. The name comes from the Greek word for eight.

questions.prompt: How many straight sides does the shape in the picture have?

image.alt: A green round shape with one smooth curved edge and no corners.

questions.explanation: It is a circle. Its edge is one smooth curve, so it has no straight sides and no corners.

questions.prompt: The shape in the picture has four right angles, but two of its sides are longer than the other two. What is it called?

image.alt: An orange flat shape with four right angles, much wider than it is tall: two long sides on the top and bottom, two short sides on the left and right.

questions.explanation: A rectangle has four right angles. A square is a special rectangle whose four sides are all the same length.
